title: Semantic Context Handoff with On-Demand Evidence for Long-Horizon Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.24357v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Traditional long-horizon LLM agents often hand off context through full-history prompting, retaining all previous action--observation interactions. As execution proceeds, this history keeps growing, increasing inference cost and potentially degrading accuracy. Existing methods control this growth by preserving compact conclusions while removing earlier observations, but doing so can discard evidence that later becomes relevant. We introduce Semantic Context Handoff (SCH), whose central abstraction is state--evidence separation: a compact semantic state carries the agent's current interpretation, while supporting action--observation evidence remains separately addressable and can re-enter context when later execution makes it relevant, without separate summarization or retrieval-model calls. tldr: 提出语义上下文交接（SCH）方法，通过状态-证据分离，让紧凑语义状态承载当前解读、证据可按需重新进入上下文，从而在大幅降低上下文成本的同时提升长时程智能体性能。
en_tdlr: Semantic Context Handoff (SCH) introduces state-evidence separation, where a compact semantic state carries the agent's current interpretation while evidence can re-enter context on demand, improving long-horizon agent performance while substantially reducing context cost.
